KAVITA YADAV

Business Analyst || Project Management || Scrum Master

Bringing extensive experience in Business Analysis and Quality Assurance in Financial Services, with a proven record of delivering Agile-driven, stakeholder-centric solutions for leading UK banks like Lloyds and HSBC on the client side. Targeting a hybrid role as a Business Analyst, Project Manager or Scrum Master to contribute to agile-led transformation in dynamic financial environments.

PROFILE SUMMARY

− Dynamic Business Analyst with over 8 years of domain expertise, backed by 14 years of professional experience, leading regulatory, digital, and business change initiatives across Tier 1 UK clients in Life & Pensions, Insurance, and Banking sectors.

− Showcased excellence in end-to-end requirements elicitation, gap analysis, and stakeholder engagement, translating regulatory mandates into actionable business solutions using industry-standard methodologies.

− Proficient in driving FCA-compliant implementations such as Fund Closures, Remediation, PPI, Plevin Commission and Customer Communication programs—ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and audit readiness.

− Proven capability to lead business process re-engineering initiatives, design 'as-is' and 'to-be' process maps, and facilitate impact assessments and option analysis to guide senior stakeholder decision-making.

− Expertise in Agile and Waterfall methodologies, with proficiency in JIRA, team framework

SharePoint, RAID/RACI coordination across onshore/offshore delivery models.

and

cross-functional

− Delivered critical change projects on digital platforms like TCS BaNCS and Mainframes, supporting migration programmes, actuarial updates and compliance-driven MI reporting.

− Recognized as a collaborative change enabler with excellent interpersonal and communication skills; consistently drives business value through structured analysis, documentation excellence & post-implementation support.

CAREER TIMELINE

2006-07 SynergyOne, Gurugram

2012-13

Freelance

2017 - 18

~2022

2009-12

2013-17

2019-22

ACHIEVEMENTS

− Spearheaded business analysis for critical Fund Management and fund closure changes on TCS BaNCS for Lloyds Banking Group, ensuring timely and accurate delivery across SDLC phases.

− Delivered end-to-end business requirements for FCA compliance and regulatory change initiatives including National Minimum Pension Age Updates, PPI, Plevin Commission, payments and Lifestyle Remediation. − Authored detailed functional and non-functional requirements, health check scripts & process maps outlining current and future state customer journeys.

− Led Project Working Groups (PWGs), facilitating artefact analysis using GAP Analyse, Stakeholder Workshops, Business Cases BRD, FRD, Used Cases, User Stories, Roadmaps and Process Flowchart to drive actionable outcomes & project clarity.

− Enabled informed decision-making by preparing option papers, business

proposals, and effort estimates for strategic project investments.

− Built strong Risk & Compliance Teams across business, IT, actuarial, operations and compliance teams in a high-performing onshore-offshore delivery model.

DOMAIN EXPERTISE & CLIENTS MANAGED

− Domains: Banking, Life & Pensions, Insurance, Mortgages, Loans & Credit Cards − Clients: LBG, Scottish Widows, HSBC, Vodafone

+91-8882343726

vibhued@gmail.com

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Analysis

Business Process Reengineering

Functional & Non-Functional Requirements

Business Transformation

Agile/ Scrum Methodologies

Product Backlog Management

Stakeholder Engagement

Process Improvement

Project Management

MI & Reporting Dashboards

UAT Planning & Execution

Customer Journey Mapping

Business Strategy Alignment

Continuous Improvement

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Data Governance and Quality Assurance

Risk Assessment and Mitigation

TECHNICAL SKILLS

− Tools: SharePoint, JIRA, Confluence, Visio − Systems: BaNCS, Mainframes

SOFT SKILLS

− Strategic Leadership & Team Management − Effective Communication − Decision-Making & Problem-Solving − Resilience & Adaptability − Change Management − Critical Thinking & Analytical Skills

EDUCATION

− MBA in HR & Marketing from Rai Business

School, New Delhi | 2006

− B.Sc. from International College for Girls,

Jaipur, Rajasthan University | 2004

CERTIFICATIONS

− Scrum Master Certification | Pursuing

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Business Analyst Allegis Group (Client: HSBC) Jul 2025 – Present Project: Global Markets Regulatory Reporting Automation Key Responsibilities

Working as Senior Business Analyst supporting Global Markets Regulatory Reporting transformation and automation initiatives.

Conducting requirement gathering workshops with Regulatory Reporting SMEs, Operations, Risk, Data Governance and Technology teams.

Preparing Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), User Stories, Process Flows, Data Mapping Documents and Impact Assessment reports.

Creating end-to-end data flow diagrams for regulatory reports by identifying source systems, upstream/downstream dependencies, data refineries, transformation layers and reporting platforms. • Performing detailed analysis of regulatory reporting processes to identify automation opportunities,

process gaps, control weaknesses and data quality issues.

Collaborating with business and technology teams to define future-state reporting processes and automated reporting solutions.

Supporting change management and business readiness activities including stakeholder communications, governance updates and implementation planning.

Managing RAID logs, requirement traceability, action trackers and governance reporting. • Coordinating SIT, UAT, defect management, release readiness and post-production support activities. • Preparing executive-level governance packs, project status reports, risk assessments and progress updates for senior leadership.

Supporting strategic automation initiatives to improve reporting accuracy, operational efficiency and regulatory compliance across Global Markets functions.

Aug’22 – Present | Business Analyst | Diligenta UK, Peterborough, UK (Subsidiary of TCS) Clients: Scottish Widows/LBG | Domain: Life, Pensions & Annuities Key Result Areas: − Producing detailed business requirements using the MoSCoW model, conducting risk assessment sessions, and creating RAID

logs to manage project risks effectively and ensure smooth project execution.

− Delivering key projects such as Fund Closures, Fund Name Changes, Actuarial Changes, FCA/Pension Regulatory Projects,

Customer/IFA/Trustee Mailings, Lifestyle Remediation, Migration Support, and MI for Vulnerable Customers.

− Conducting requirement workshops with business users, Ops SMEs, IT teams, actuaries and finance SMEs, while collaborating

with Client BAs, PMs, Docs Team, IT and BAT/UAT teams to deliver a cohesive change portfolio.

− Preparing detailed training materials and user guides for system and process changes, planning Go Live support, and facilitating

post-implementation training for both business and system users.

− Leading end-to-end business analysis activities by capturing, refining, and translating business needs into clear user stories and

functional requirements.

− Collaborating with senior stakeholders, product owners and cross-functional teams to define project scope, KPIs & deliverables. − Facilitating Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure team alignment and

delivery efficiency.

− Driving process improvement initiatives by identifying gaps, mapping current workflow & recommending optimization strategies. − Conducting feasibility studies & impact assessments to evaluate business readiness and regulatory implications of proposed changes. − Preparing dashboards and analytical reports to provide visibility into project health, risks, and decision-support metrics. − Supporting data governance efforts by validating data quality, lineage, and compliance with organizational standards. − Mentoring junior analysts and contributing to the continuous improvement of business analysis frameworks and best practices. − Acting as a domain SME across multiple projects, offering guidance and ensuring consistency in requirements and solutions.

May’19 – Jul’22 | Quality & Business Analyst | Equinity Paystream, UK Clients: HSBC & LBG

Sep’17 – Sep’18 | PPI Complaints Officer | Cordant People UK, Bristol, UK Client: HSBC | Domain: Banking, Insurance & Pensions

Key Result Areas: − Assessed and documented the customer side of change (CSOC) and people side of change (PSOC) for multiple upgrades and

initiatives involving Mortgages, Credit Cards, Loans, and Insurance products.

− Delivered key projects including:

o Premium Refund Calculations system update o KYC & CDD (Customer Due Diligence) o Plevin Commission & PPI Regulatory Change o Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) o ONTU Project (Offer Not Taken Up) o Batch Run Optimisation projects on legacy platforms

− Facilitated project working group (PWG) sessions, collaborated with IT and Business SMEs, and contributed to baseline

requirement finalization and design documentation.

− Supported the Quality Assurance team in drafting test design specifications and conducted thorough reviews and approvals of

business, functional, and non-functional test outputs.

− Generated weekly/monthly Management Information (MI) reports for senior stakeholders to track status, risks & progress.

PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE Jul’13 – Aug’17 | Freelance Experience Domain: Banking & Insurance

Mar’12 – Jun’13 | Compliance Audit Consultant | Conduit UK, Cardiff, UK Client: LBG | Domain: Banking & Insurance

Sep’09 – Mar’12 | Account Management Executive | Conduit 118 Ltd., (UK), Cardiff UK Client: Vodafone | Domain: Telecommunication

Nov’06 – Nov’07 | HR Executive | SynergyOne, Gurugram PERSONAL DETAILS

Address

Date of Birth Languages Known

: Delhi NCR : 14th September 1983 : English & Hindi
